I usually don't leave reviews; but I thought, why not? Someone might be struggling with the same issues I had. I hated this sunscreen when first applying. It has terrible white cast, and diffcult to rub into the skin. However I figured out how to make the experience 10x better. Do you have a foundation brush? Thermal water spray? A spray bottle of filtered is perfectly fine if you don't have a thermal water spray. Wait 5-10 minutes after moisturizer. Spray a light coat of thermal water ( or filtered water ) on. Lightly tap into your skin. Apply your sunscreen. Afterwards, use your foundation brush to pat your sunscreen in. Additional information. - Don't wait until your face is completely dry before putting on sunscreen. Ive noticed by leaving my face damp-ish; I could easyily spread the sunscreen around more. - Use whatever technique you want with your foundation brush. I pat the sunscreen in on my cheeks and forehead; but whenever it comes to creases around my nose, forehead, etc. I'm swiping with my foundation brush. - There will be a white cast when YOU FIRST APPLY. Give yourself time, and allow the product to absorb into your skin before you go out. It won't completely disappear; however it'll definitely look closer to the color of your skintone. Good luck ♥️
This product absorbed wonderfully, offered the right layering under my makeup and gave just the right amount of protection I needed for some time in the sun. Definitely recommend.

avis.titre: I'd recommend this to lighter skin tones
avis.texte: Received this item for free to test out and I'd say it was worth it. Used this for about a week in the Texas sun and it worked wonders and actually lasted. However, needed to reapply more than I thought to keep the same effect, and the only thing I did not like was the white cast it left my skin, but it wasn't by too much.
I absolutely love how smooth it goes on. It's not heavy and stays on for most of the day. It's not a greasy feel.

I received this full size sample of Cerave Hydrating Sheer Sunscreen Face&Body 30SPF in exchange for my honest opinion. Overall this is a great sunscreen, it's a broad spectrum uva/uvb protection, light weight, non greasy, blends seamlessly into skin for an invisible look, suitable for sensitive skin, water resistant for 80 minutes, has 3 essential ceramides & niacinamide and no gross smell like typical sunscreen either! I definitely will be buying this and using in my future.

avis.titre: Yes I would buy this product again
avis.texte: I used this cream as my skin morning routine before I head out. Don't even know it's on. It blends with your skin and no residue or white patch is left on my skin.

I received this product from Cerave through the BzzAgent sampling program. This product is odorless, colorless and brends very well without leaving any greasy finish. It could be a bit more hydrating. I tried with makeup and doesn't work 😞. The only reason it didn't get five stars was because of the subtle white cast it left on my skin
I love this sunscreen. I REALLY try to wear it everyday under my makeup. It goes on nice and does not leave a stick residue. I have not had any problems with breakouts since I starting using it.
This product was amazing and I absolutely loved it. I usually burn even with sunscreen but this one kept me from having sunburn

avis.titre: I definitely would buy this product
avis.texte: This product I received just in time for Vegas. I took this with me on our trip to Vegas and I loved it. I did re-apply throughout the day but it worked perfectly. Definitely purchasing in the future.
